name: agent
postStartCommand: sudo /usr/local/bin/init-firewall.sh && mkdir -p ~/.pi/agent && ([ -f ~/.pi/agent/models.json ] || cp ${containerWorkspaceFolder}/.devcontainer/models.json ~/.pi/agent/models.json) && ([ -d ~/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/rad-skill ] || claude plugin marketplace add https://seed.radicle.garden/zvBj4kByGeQSrSy2c4H7fyK42cS8.git) && ([ -d ~/.claude/plugins/cache/rad-skill/radicle ] || claude plugin install radicle@rad-skill)
